additional_info.subject: ID0398382-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / P6 170000666 ] Charging station continue to fail CRM:00641000953
additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
I trust this email finds you in good health. We have received a technical support request from
AW Automatisierungstechnik GmbH
in your region regarding the following product:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / P6 170000666
Charger ID/Serial No.:
1bhhGK
Problem Description: Charging station continue to fail (Unable to charge the vehicle)
We have checked the charger on SCB and it was offline since
01/07/2025, 12:06 AM,
so w
e are unable to resolve the issue remotely without SCB connectivity. A site visit is recommended to check the following
Ensure the router is connected to the internet.
Verify the charger is powered.
Potential Causes for Charger Disconnection on SCB
Internet Connectivity Issues (Siemens Router)
WAN failover switched from Cellular to Ethernet.
Perform a hard reset via "OCPP" or reboot the charger locally (if connected to OCPP server).
Mobile Network Operator Issues
SIM card disabled/expired or inserted incorrectly. Clean and reinsert into XF3/XF4 router.
Monthly data volume exhausted.
Weak signal strength due to changing radio conditions.
M2M contract lacks IP enablement.
Backend Issues
Backend changes in charger settings.
OCPP server on the backend is unavailable.
Teltonika Router Issues
Router switched to an incorrect network service (e.g., 3G instead of 4G).
Hardware failure of the router.
Router software crash.
Once the charger online on SCB then we recommend upgrading your charger’s firmware with latest. These updates typically include bug fixes, performance enhancements, and improved compatibility with electric vehicle communication protocols. By doing so, you can mitigate the errors you’ve been facing and if the issue still persists then we can proceed further to trouble shoot reported issue which is mentioned by the customer.
but, upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since [
08/06/2024
], as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
For additional information, please visit the Service Collaboration SharePoint. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.

Abhinav Malokar
